normative_extracts.quote: Signals use a push-pull algorithm: writes eagerly push dirty state down the graph, while reads lazily pull and recompute only when an upstream dependency actually changed.
Direct children of a changed source are marked Dirty, while transitive descendants are marked Check so they verify upstream versions before recomputing.
Replacing per-node Set allocations with doubly-linked list nodes cuts memory overhead and allows O(1) subscription addition and stale edge pruning.

browser_support.notes: Implemented in userland JavaScript across all modern engines (V8, SpiderMonkey, JavaScriptCore); native TC39 Signal namespace remains Stage 1.

pipeline_phases: Push Phase: Eager Dirty and Check state propagation
Batch Boundary: Enqueue affected side-effect sinks
Pull Phase: Depth-first upstream verification of Check nodes
Equality Cutoff: Short-circuit downstream execution on Object.is match
Edge Pruning: Unlink stale subscriptions from dynamic branches
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: A directed acyclic reactive graph executes on the JS main thread by splitting invalidation into an eager push pass that colors direct subscribers Dirty and transitive subscribers Check, followed by a lazy pull pass that resolves dependencies in topological order and skips recomputation when upstream outputs are unchanged.

production_failures.symptom: RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded during initial render or state update.
production_failures.root_cause: A derived computed signal reads its own value directly or through a mutual dependency cycle (A -> B -> A), causing infinite recursion during the pull phase.
production_failures.mitigation: Track an explicit Computing state flag per node during pull traversal and throw a deterministic cycle-detection error before recursing.

production_failures.symptom: Monotonically rising JS heap size and phantom recomputations in long-lived SPAs.
production_failures.root_cause: Dynamic conditional branches (e.g., flag() ? a() : b()) retain old subscriber links to inactive signals when the runtime omits versioned edge pruning after re-evaluation.
production_failures.mitigation: Stamp each dependency edge with a monotonic evaluation epoch and unlink any incoming source edge whose epoch was not refreshed during the latest pull.

production_failures.symptom: Duplicate API requests or forced layout thrashing inside synchronous state-update loops.
production_failures.root_cause: Calling signal.set() multiple times without a batch boundary flushes the effect queue after every individual write instead of coalescing the transaction.
production_failures.mitigation: Wrap multi-signal mutations in a batch() transaction so the push phase marks all affected nodes before the effect queue flushes once.
